title: OfficialNotice
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.2 and hard invariant 40. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.notices.OfficialNotice). STEP 1 OF 3 of the notice trust boundary: an authorized notice OBJECT. Issuing it starts nothing - no deadline runs, no presumption applies, no legal effect exists. `authorized_methods` is the closed set of channels over which this notice may validly be served; an attempt over any other method is refused at recording time with NOTICE_METHOD_INVALID. `content_reference` points at PACK-11 content; PACK-09 stores no notice body. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
